earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Net income was $606 million versus $512 million last year, while earnings per share were $1.91 compared to $1.58 per share in the prior year period.
Total sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 increased a robust 12% versus last year, with comparable store sales up a strong 8%, primarily driven by customer traffic.
Third quarter operating margin of 12.3% increased 70 basis points compared to last year, above the Company’s plan of 11.7% to 12.0%.
Sales for the third quarter increased 12% to $6.3 billion, up from $5.6 billion in 2025.
Comparable store sales rose a strong 8% for the quarter on top of a 7% gain last year.
outlook: Earnings per share for the third quarter of $1.91 exceeded our guidance of $1.75 to $1.83.

items.group: MACROECONOMIC AND RETAIL INDUSTRY BUSINESS RISKS

items.heading: We depend on the market availability, quantity, and quality of attractive brand name merchandise at desirable discounts, and on the ability of our buyers to source and purchase merchandise to enable us to offer customers a wide assortment of merchandise at competitive prices.

Our inability to continually attract, train, and retain associates with the retail talent necessary to execute our off-price retail strategies, as well as labor shortages, increased turnover, or increased labor costs could adversely affect our operating results.
